item.title: Why many Black Americans feel a special kinship with Dolly Parton
item.description: The late superstar Dolly Parton had an incredible legacy in American culture. That was even true from a Black American viewpoint. The Black Wall Street Times' Nehemiah Frank describes Parton's impact.
item.content:encoded: The late superstar Dolly Parton had an incredible legacy in American culture. That was even true from a Black American viewpoint. The Black Wall Street Times' Nehemiah Frank describes Parton's impact.
item.dc:creator: Jordan-Marie Smith

item.title: When is suspending students discrimination? Education Department renews an old fight
item.description: President Trump's Education Department is telling schools to stop considering race when it comes to school discipline.
item.content:encoded: President Trump's Education Department is telling schools to stop considering race when it comes to school discipline.
item.dc:creator: Cory Turner

item.title: A professor's death brings new focus to how Black academics are treated
item.description: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Professor Shaun Harper about the intense media scrutiny of British sociologist Jason Arday and how the scholar's death has reverberated in Black academic circles.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Professor Shaun Harper about the intense media scrutiny of British sociologist Jason Arday and how the scholar's death has reverberated in Black academic circles.
item.dc:creator: Jeffrey Pierre

item.title: Remembering the Sand Creek Massacre through one objector's letters
item.description: In 1864, Captain Silas Soule of the 1st Colorado Cavalry refused orders to kill innocent Native Americans. He wrote letters about the massacre, which may have changed the course of history.
item.content:encoded: In 1864, Captain Silas Soule of the 1st Colorado Cavalry refused orders to kill innocent Native Americans. He wrote letters about the massacre, which may have changed the course of history.
item.dc:creator: Debbie Elliott

item.title: A federal lawsuit challenges the development of a whites-only community in Arkansas
item.description: A gated community called Return to the Land in the northeastern Ozarks was designed exclusively for white people. A St. Louis realtor is challenging the plans after her application was rejected.
item.content:encoded: A gated community called Return to the Land in the northeastern Ozarks was designed exclusively for white people. A St. Louis realtor is challenging the plans after her application was rejected.
item.dc:creator: Jacqueline Froelich

item.title: At Mississippi funeral, civil rights leaders call for justice for Nolan Wells, 18
item.description: The parents of Nolan Wells, who was found dead on Horn Island in Mississippi, held a funeral for the 18-year-old on Monday. Wells was with friends for the Fourth of July and did not return home.

item.title: The Supreme Court said racism wasn't factor a in TPS ruling. Haitians think otherwise
item.description: President Trump has denigrated Haitian immigrants with language they consider racist. In its ruling allowing Trump to end TPS, the Supreme Court rejected that the administration was motivated by race.

item.title: How the 1874 Freedman's Bank collapse connects to economic disparities we see today
item.description: In Savings and Trust, historian Justene Hill Edwards tells the story of the Freedman's Bank, which was created for formerly enslaved people following the Civil War. Originally broadcast Nov. 7, 2024.

item.title: As the U.S. turns 250, this historian has blunt advice: 'America has to grow up'
item.description: In America, U.S.A., Princeton historian Eddie Glaude Jr. looks at the country through the lens of its previous anniversaries and centennials. "The divided soul of the nation is in full view," he says.

item.title: 'Race Unwrapped' podcast explores art as protest
item.description: The new season of the 'Race Unwrapped' podcast looks at art as a force for social change. Host Michelle Tyrene Johnson talks to NPR's Adrian Florido about the intersection of storytelling and protest.
